title: Pollo al ajillo (garlic chicken) with oven potatoes and salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with 1 tsp oil, paprika and salt and bake for 25 minutes.
Cut the chicken into pieces, season with salt and pepper and brown all over in the remaining oil for 8 minutes.
Add the unpeeled, lightly crushed garlic cloves and thyme and fry for 2 minutes.
Add the stock and lemon juice and reduce for 5 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the potatoes and a tomato salad.
